info.title: API.SH: Woolworths
info.description: The Woolworths API from API.SH: public Woolworths data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The Woolworths shop's departments and aisles as a tree: id, name, level, parent, slug, link, specials and restricted flags.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/woolworths-categories

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Return only this branch (a category id such as 1_6E4F4E4, or its slug such as dairy-eggs-fridge).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Woolworths product by stockcode, link or barcode: everything in search (price, unit price, promotion, availability, ingredients, allergens, dietary claims, health star rating, nutrition per 100 g and per serve, storage and usage) plus all product attributes, the star rating, rating count and recent reviews. `gtin13` is the 13-digit barcode printed on the pack (EAN-13), derived from Woolworths' own `barcode` (mostly a 14-digit GTIN-14: indicator digit dropped, check digit recomputed; 13-digit codes kept, 12-digit UPC-A padded); null when `barcode` is missing or has a wrong check digit, and for in-store numbers (02, 04, 20-29: items weighed or packed in store, such as loose fruit or bakery bread) that are not a product barcode. With `postcode` or `store`, `location.store` is that store (or the nearest supermarket to the postcode that lists the product) with `instore_available` (null when the site does not say), and `store_availability` lists the nearby supermarkets the site shows (up to 5) (number, name, address, distance) and whether each has the product in stock; prices stay the site's online prices, the same for every signed-out shopper (`prices_for_location` false). The list is empty for products the site sells online only.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/woolworths-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The stockcode (the number in a woolworths.com.au/shop/productdetails/<id>/... link) or that link. Required unless `barcode` is given.

parameters.name: barcode
parameters.description: Look the product up by the barcode on the pack instead of `id`: the 13-digit EAN (e.g. 9300633556167), or a 14-digit GTIN / 12-digit UPC. Matched exactly on `gtin13`; 404 when Woolworths has no product with it.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: 4-digit Australian postcode: adds in-store availability at the nearest supermarkets (`location`, `store_availability`).

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: Store number from /woolworths/v1/stores (e.g. 1449): adds whether that store has the product in stock (`location.store.instore_available`) and nearby stores (`store_availability`). 404 for an unknown store number.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Woolworths (Australia) product search: stockcode, barcode, name, brand, link, package size, price, was price and savings, unit price (per kg/L), in-store price, special / half-price flags, promotion text, multibuy and member prices, stock and availability for delivery, pickup and express, departments and categories, ingredients, allergens (contains / may contain), dietary and lifestyle claims, health star rating, nutrition panel per 100 g and per serve, images, and size variants. `gtin13` is the 13-digit barcode printed on the pack (EAN-13), derived from Woolworths' own `barcode` (mostly a 14-digit GTIN-14: indicator digit dropped, check digit recomputed; 13-digit codes kept, 12-digit UPC-A padded); null when `barcode` is missing or has a wrong check digit, and for in-store numbers (02, 04, 20-29: items weighed or packed in store, such as loose fruit or bakery bread) that are not a product barcode. `location` says what the prices are for: woolworths.com.au shows the same online prices to every signed-out shopper and lets only signed-in shoppers choose a store or delivery address, so `prices_for_location` is always false; `selected` is false with no `postcode`/`store`. `facets` lists the departments the results fall into; `related_searches` the site's suggested refinements. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/woolworths-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search keywords.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: relevance (default), price_asc, price_desc, unit_price_asc, unit_price_desc, name.

parameters.name: specials
parameters.description: true for products on special only.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Products per page, 10-36 (default 24).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: 4-digit Australian postcode. Echoed in `location`; prices stay the site's online prices (it lets only signed-in shoppers choose a store). In-store availability near a postcode is on /woolworths/v1/product.

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: Store number from /woolworths/v1/stores (e.g. 1449). Echoed in `location`; prices stay the site's online prices. In-store availability at a store is on /woolworths/v1/product.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Woolworths (Australia) specials by group (half price, lower shelf price, everyday low price, seasonal price, buy more save more, online only, bundles, Everyday Market), optionally narrowed to one department: total, and each product's stockcode, name, brand, link, package size, price, was price and savings, unit price, special / half-price flags, promotion text, multibuy and member prices, stock and availability, sponsored flag, departments, ingredients, allergens, dietary claims, health star rating, nutrition and images. `gtin13` is the 13-digit barcode printed on the pack (EAN-13), derived from Woolworths' own `barcode` (mostly a 14-digit GTIN-14: indicator digit dropped, check digit recomputed; 13-digit codes kept, 12-digit UPC-A padded); null when `barcode` is missing or has a wrong check digit, and for in-store numbers (02, 04, 20-29: items weighed or packed in store, such as loose fruit or bakery bread) that are not a product barcode. `location` says what the prices are for: woolworths.com.au shows the same online prices to every signed-out shopper and lets only signed-in shoppers choose a store or delivery address, so `prices_for_location` is always false; `selected` is false with no `postcode`/`store`. `facets` lists brands, allergens, dietary and health star filters with counts; `groups` and `departments` list the values to pass back. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/woolworths-specials

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Specials group (default half-price): half-price, lower-shelf-price, everyday-low-price, seasonal-price, buy-more-save-more, online-only-specials, bundles, everyday-market-specials-and-offers; the response's `groups` lists the current ones.

parameters.name: department
parameters.description: Only this department of the group, e.g. `pantry`, `drinks`, `freezer` (the response's `departments` lists them).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order (default relevance).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Products per page (default 24, 10-36).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; null on the last page.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: 4-digit Australian postcode. Echoed in `location`; prices stay the site's online prices (it lets only signed-in shoppers choose a store). In-store availability near a postcode is on /woolworths/v1/product.

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: Store number from /woolworths/v1/stores (e.g. 1449). Echoed in `location`; prices stay the site's online prices. In-store availability at a store is on /woolworths/v1/product.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Woolworths stores nearest an Australian postcode: store number, name, division, address, suburb, state, postcode, phone, coordinates, distance in km, open now, trading hours for the week ahead and facilities.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/woolworths-stores

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: 4-digit Australian postcode.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Stores to return, 1-50 (default 10).

parameters.name: division
parameters.description: Store type: SUPERMARKETS (default, includes Metro stores), PETROL, AMPOL, AMPOLMETRO, CALTEXWOW, EG; several comma-separated.

parameters.name: facility
parameters.description: Only stores with this facility (as named in `facilities`).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
